core.command: go test ./... && go test -race ./... && go vet ./... && go mod verify && go test -tags oracle ./conformance ./jsonata

public.command: go -C javascript test ./... && go -C javascript test -race ./... && go -C javascript vet ./... && go -C javascript mod verify && python3 javascript/scripts/test_check_module.py && python3 javascript/scripts/check_module.py

assessment.command: go -C experiments/javascript test ./... && go -C experiments/javascript test -race ./... && go -C experiments/javascript vet ./... && go -C experiments/javascript mod verify && go -C experiments/javascript test -run ^$ -fuzz ^FuzzStringConversion$ -fuzztime=1000x -parallel=2

owned_probes.command: CGO_ENABLED=0 go -C experiments/javascript build -o /tmp/jsontrans-pr-a-assess ./cmd/assess && python3 experiments/javascript/run_probes.py --binary /tmp/jsontrans-pr-a-assess --backend owned-quickjs --strict --output /tmp/jsontrans-pr-a-owned-probes.json

platform_execution: CI required; cross-target scans do not execute target binaries
